verdict.line: You lose if you let Yorick stack Mist Walkers and grave-dig uncontested before level 6; you win every trade once your [P] Darkness Rise aura is up.

brief.thesis: This matchup sits at 52.1% over 1084 games because Mordekaiser's E (Death's Grasp) ignores Yorick's ability to kite with Q (Last Rites) empowered autos — a 700-range pull yanks him out of his dig animation before the grave finishes. Mordekaiser wins the sustained trade once [P] Darkness Rise is active; Yorick wins only if he's allowed to poke from range and dig graves uninterrupted for Mist Walkers.

theirWindow.when: Q is up and he's digging a grave
theirWindow.what: He's rooted in the dig animation and his Mist Walker count is about to grow. If you can't reach him before it finishes, back off rather than eating a fresh Walker's attack speed buff.

yourWindow.when: He walks forward to land Q or E
yourWindow.what: Immediately E (Death's Grasp) to pull him in, then Q (Obliterate) — the single-target bonus on Q punishes him for being alone in melee range before any Walkers arrive.

powerCurve.note: R fight-win potential, full build online

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: 50.6% win rate over 1031 games and the 72.9% pick — the mana and sustain let you throw E-Q every cooldown window without running dry against his poke.

boots.why: 49.2% win rate over 1039 games and the 77.5% pick — his empowered Q autos and Walker swarm are physical damage, and the flat reduction blunts both.

core.why: slows both target and anyone caught in E's pull, making it near-impossible for Yorick to walk his dug grave away from your follow-up Q
sustained-damage ramp that pairs with [P] Darkness Rise to win any extended trade once the fight lasts past the first exchange
62.1% win rate over 103 games on this exact path — burn damage keeps ticking through his W (Dark Procession) wall if he tries to split the fight

situational.when: he builds lifesteal or his Maiden's bonus damage on-hit is doing more than expected
his sustained Walker-swarm damage outpaces your Riftmaker ramp and you need more raw healing from your shield-consume
he's fully committed to the physical-damage Walker swarm early and OP.GG's own tip to buy it against his [P] is correct

runes.keystoneWhy: stacks through repeated E-Q trades and Walker-swarm exchanges, converting the extended melee grind this matchup becomes into straight healing and damage

summoners.why: 80.2% pick rate at 50.7% win — Ignite denies the healing off his Q (Last Rites) lifesteal proc during all-ins, which is the exact tool he leans on to win extended trades

playing.title: Pull before he digs twice
playing.detail: Land E (Death's Grasp) the moment he commits to a second grave-dig animation — interrupting the dig denies the Walker and the fight becomes 1v1 melee, which you win.

playing.title: Track his W wall placement
playing.detail: Dark Procession has a 600 range and blocks movement; don't walk into a position where he can wall you off from your own tower or minions mid-trade.

playing.title: Trade only after landing 3 hits
playing.detail: [P] Darkness Rise needs 3 attacks or spells on a champion or monster to activate — bait his poke onto minions early if you need the aura up before an all-in.

playing.title: Hold R for his Maiden window
playing.detail: Realm of Death (650 range, 140s base cooldown) is your win condition once he hits level 6 and the Maiden is active — stealing his stats mid-fight removes the bonus damage his autos get against the Maiden's target.

playing.title: Shield-stack before every trade
playing.detail: W (Indestructible) stores damage dealt and taken — pre-trigger it on minion damage before E-ing him so the shield is already banked when the Walkers arrive.

playing.title: Punish solo Yorick, not Maiden Yorick
playing.detail: Your solo-kill advantage in this matchup is real, but it only holds pre-6 or when his Maiden is on cooldown — don't force all-ins once Eulogy of the Isles is up and Walkers can swarm you.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and the 52.1%-over-1084-games number are measured OP.GG data from current live games on this patch; the lane-execution reasoning — when to pull, when to all-in, how [P] interacts with the trade — is my own tactical read, not sourced from the stat page.

stats.opponentTip: Pressure Yorick during early game to gain lane control. Purchase Bramble Vest and maintain your [P] when fighting him.
